◫ Video comparison study

Video comparison study

Before you start

  1. Use a laptop or desktop. Watch both full videos. Judge quality at 1× speed; use the speed slider to review.
  2. Compare returning objects and places, flicker, and visual quality separately.
  3. Choose About the same for a tie. Choose Cannot judge if there is not enough evidence—for example, no recognizable return.
  4. Work independently. Please do not inspect video filenames or discuss preferences during the study.

Each set has up to 15 comparisons, usually 20–30 minutes. Your answers are saved automatically. Use the same nickname and browser when you return.

Your nickname and ratings are visible to the study organizer. Please use a nickname instead of your full name. Unfinished sets are held for seven days.
